entries.query:
technologiai stack 

válaszodban szeretném ha csak listába írnád írnád a dolgokat amiket keresek, minden más nélkül.
entries.answer:
- Julia (Flux, CUDA, Zygote, Optimisers, ChainRulesCore, HTTP, JSON3)
- Elixir (GenServer, Task, HTTPoison, Jason, ETS, Node/cluster)
- Haskell (Aeson, Yaml, Text, Vector, Map; configuration system)
- Python (FastAPI server integration, training orchestration; google-auth, googleapiclient)
- Model architectures: RetNet, Mamba/Mamba2, GQA, Hybrid AMF (Attention–Mamba Fusion)
- Attention/efficiency: TransMLA, FlashMLA, DeepSeek MLA, PagedAttention/vLLM
- Position embeddings: ComRoPE, YaRN, SEAL
- Sparsity/optimization: 2:4 structured sparsity, V:N:M sparsity, Expert sparsity control, SpInfer, DSMoE/eMoE, MegaScale-Infer
- Quantization: FP8 Hopper, Adaptive bit allocation, BitNet/Ternary
- Adapters: VeRA, DoRA
- Generation control: LLMSteer
- Tokenization/lang utils: Hungarian-specialized preprocessing and vocab
- Orchestration/infra: Docker/Docker Compose, Nginx (reverse proxy)
- GCP services: IAM/service account, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Compute Engine, Monitoring, Logging, Cloud Build
- Deployment targets: VPS (217.154.3.15), GCP auto-scaling GPU instances
- Distributed/infra modules: Distributed KV cache (ETS), Zero-offload memory manager (GPU/CPU/disk tiers)
- APIs/ports: Julia bridge (8888), Elixir API (4000), Python app (5000)
